scripts.build: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs build sh -c 'npm run tokens:check && npm run build:packages && npm run catalog:check && npm run pack:local && npm run docs:install && npm run docs:generate && npm run docs:check && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:consumers && npm run build:previews && npm run examples:verify && npm run guides:verify && npm run build:thumbnails && npm run build:guide-figures && npm run build:design-figures && npm --prefix apps/docs run build "$@"' --
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs typecheck sh -c 'npm run examples:generate && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p apps/docs/tsconfig.json --noEmit "$@"' --
scripts.test: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs test sh -c 'npm run verify:current && node --test tests/*.test.mjs "$@"' --
scripts.test:browser:smoke: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs test:browser:smoke sh -c 'node scripts/browser-test.mjs --profile smoke "$@"' --
scripts.test:browser:related: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs test:browser:related sh -c 'node scripts/browser-test.mjs --profile related "$@"' --
scripts.setup: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs setup sh -c 'npm ci && npm run setup:browsers && npm run tokens:generate && npm run build "$@"' --
scripts.setup:browsers: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs setup:browsers sh -c 'playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit "$@"' --
scripts.docs:generate: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs docs:generate sh -c 'npm run api:generate && npm run guides:generate && node scripts/icon-docs.mjs && node scripts/discovery.mjs && node scripts/coverage.mjs && node scripts/accessibility.mjs "$@"' --
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs docs:check sh -c 'npm run api:check && npm run guides:check && node scripts/icon-docs.mjs --check && node scripts/discovery.mjs --check && node scripts/coverage.mjs --check && node scripts/accessibility.mjs --check "$@"' --
scripts.examples:verify: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs examples:verify sh -c 'node scripts/example-consumers.mjs && node scripts/example-consumers.mjs --usage "$@"' --
scripts.test:docs:smoke: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs test:docs:smoke sh -c 'node scripts/docs-test.mjs --profile smoke "$@"' --
scripts.test:docs:related: node scripts/workflow-run.mjs test:docs:related sh -c 'node scripts/docs-test.mjs --profile related "$@"' --
